run_tactile_pose_estimation: run the tactile pose estimation example script with hydra config for 2D object pose tracking
run_learning_loop: run the tactile pushing training loop that computes train and validation losses per epoch
create_TactilePushingTrainer: create a TactilePushingTrainer instance from theseus utils to optimize 2D object poses from tactile images
visualize_tactile_push2d: visualize optimized and ground truth 2D object and end-effector poses as trajectory plots
main_entry_point: run the hydra-decorated main entry point that sets random seeds and starts the learning loop
